decision_object.trigger_condition: Competitor raised $40M for mid-market; 2 inbound SMB-scale leads/mo
decision_object.evidence_threshold: Direct customer-demand signal required before acting on competitor raise
decision_object.decision_criteria: Positive LTV:CAC AND product fit at mid-market scale
decision_object.expected_outcome: Validated thesis or fatal misfit within 90 days
decision_object.actual_outcome: Discovery: mid-market needs self-serve; we are sales-led only
decision_object.learning_extracted: Competitor raises alone are insufficient demand proof

learning_ledger.case: Should we enter the mid-market segment?
learning_ledger.assumption: Mid-market reachable with a lighter packaging motion
learning_ledger.cause: Our motion cannot serve smaller buyers efficiently
learning_ledger.learning: Competitor funding is a weak demand signal without direct proof
learning_ledger.rule_update: Require direct customer-demand signal before acting on competitor raises
